name: Lupa
description: AI-native veterinary OS replacing 7+ point solutions
note: Latest round is the $20M Series A (Oct 2025).

name: Wexler
description: AI fact intelligence for complex litigation
note: Legora announced its acquisition of Wexler on 29 Jul 2026; terms not disclosed. Raised $6.7M: a $1.4M pre-seed and a $5.3M seed.

name: La Fraise
description: AI agents automating dental practice admin workflows
note: Latest round is the €3.2M seed (Nov 2025).

name: Accrual
description: AI-native tax preparation and review platform for accounting firms
note: No change found since launching with $75M (Feb 2026).

name: Avantos
description: AI operating system for financial services client onboarding and servicing
note: Latest round is the $25M Series A led by Bessemer (Feb 2026).

name: Hypatos
description: Deep learning for financial document automation
note: No funding news in 2026; total raised not independently confirmed.

name: Harvey
description: AI platform for legal professionals — research, contracts, document review
note: Raised $550M at $15.6B, co-led by Lightspeed and Diffusion (Sep 2026), six months after $200M at $11B; more than $1.5B raised in total.

name: Stacks
description: AI-powered financial close and accounting automation for enterprises
note: No change found since the $23M Series A (Feb 2026).

name: Flinn.ai
description: AI platform for medtech regulatory compliance
note: Raised €17M led by HV Capital (Feb 2026); about $30M raised in total.

name: Burst
description: Payments platform letting retailers accept FSA/HSA health-account spending
note: Formerly Float. Raised a $2.1M seed led by Pear VC (Feb 2026).

name: Comand AI
description: AI-native command and control software for military operations
note: Raised a €32M Series A led by Blossom Capital, with Saab as a strategic investor (Jun 2026). Total is an estimate: the source gives about $12M raised before this round.

name: Vizgard
description: Edge-based visual AI for defence and surveillance
note: Latest round is £1.5M (Jan 2025).

name: SIYTE
description: AI operational intelligence for rail and critical infrastructure
note: Purple Transform Ltd now trades as SIYTE. No new round since £4.5M (Sep 2024).

name: Physical Intelligence
description: General-purpose AI foundation models for robotics
note: Raised a $600M Series B at $5.6B led by CapitalG (Nov 2025). Reported in talks to raise about $1B at $11B (Bloomberg, Mar 2026); no close confirmed.

name: Neuracore
description: Unified cloud-native robot learning platform
note: No change found since the $3M pre-seed (Nov 2025).

name: Isembard
description: Software-run precision machining factories for aerospace and defence
note: Raised a $50M Series A led by Union Square Ventures (Mar 2026) to open 25 factories.

name: Arda
description: AI platform for autonomous manufacturing and Western supply chain reshoring
note: Reported (WSJ) to have raised $70M at a $700M valuation, co-led by Founders Fund and Accel (Mar 2026); round not named.

name: Orca.AI
description: Autonomous navigation and collision avoidance for commercial ships
note: No new round since the $72.5M Series B (May 2025); $111M raised in total.

name: Complyance
description: AI agents for governance, risk & compliance
note: Latest round is the $20M Series A led by GV (Feb 2026).

name: Cogent Security
description: AI taskforce for autonomous vulnerability management
note: Latest round is the $42M Series A (Feb 2026).

name: Pillar
description: End-to-end AI security platform for enterprise AI applications
note: No change found since the $9M seed.

name: BeyondMath
description: Physics foundation model for engineering-grade simulation
note: Raised a $10M seed extension led by Cambridge Innovation Capital (Feb 2026).

name: Helsing
description: Defence AI software for sensing, targeting and electronic warfare
note: Raised a $1.8B Series E at $18B (Jul 2026) with Dragoneer, Lightspeed and Goldman Sachs Alternatives among the investors. Earlier rounds not yet totalled.

name: Quantum Systems
description: Long-range drones for reconnaissance and mapping
note: Raised a $1.2B Series D at over $8B (Jul 2026), co-led by Blackstone, Noteus, Airbus and Advent. Earlier rounds not yet totalled.

name: Tekever
description: Uncrewed aircraft systems for maritime and land surveillance
note: First close of a $580M Series D at $6.4B (Sep 2026), led by UC Investments and Baillie Gifford.

name: Stark
description: Autonomous strike and surveillance drones
note: Reported (Bloomberg) to have raised €500M at €3.2–3.5B, backed by Sequoia and Founders Fund (Jun 2026). Earlier rounds not yet totalled.

name: ARX Robotics
description: Uncrewed ground vehicles and an operating system for military robots
note: Raised a €31M Series A led by HV Capital, with the NATO Innovation Fund and Project A; reportedly extended to €42M.

name: Wayve
description: Embodied AI for autonomous driving
note: Raised a $1.2B Series D at $8.6B (Feb 2026), led by Eclipse, Balderton and SoftBank Vision Fund 2, with further milestone-based funding from Uber. Earlier rounds not yet totalled.

name: Humanoid
description: General-purpose humanoid robots for industrial work
note: Raised a $152M Series A led by Prime Movers Lab at $1.35B (Jul 2026), taking its total to $270M; Bosch will manufacture its robots.

name: Anterior
description: AI for health-insurance prior authorisation and clinical review
note: Closed a $40M round (Feb 2026; round not named), taking its total to $64M; NEA and Sequoia continued, FPV and Kinnevik joined.

name: Crosby
description: AI-native law firm handling contracts end to end
note: Raised a $60M Series B at $400M, co-led by Lux Capital and Index Ventures (Mar 2026), after a $20M Series A (Oct 2025) and a $5.8M seed: about $86M in total.

name: C1
description: Identity governance for people and AI agents: scoped access, policies, human approval and an audit trail
note: Formerly ConductorOne. Workday agreed to acquire it on 13 Oct 2026, expected to close by the end of January 2027; terms not disclosed.

name: Halluminate
description: RL environments and benchmarks that teach frontier models professional work, starting with finance
note: Raised a $30M Series A led by Oak HC/FT (Oct 2026), taking its total to $38.5M; finance first, then consulting and insurance.

name: Mercor
description: Marketplace of vetted domain experts who create training data and evaluations for AI labs
note: Raised a $350M Series C at $10B (Oct 2025); reported in talks at about $20B (Jul 2026), no close confirmed.

name: micro1
description: AI interviewer that finds and vets experts, who then produce training data for AI labs
note: Reported (Forbes, Sep 2026) to have raised more than $100M at a $4B valuation, eight times its value a year earlier.

name: Symbal
description: AI interviews, identity checks and matching to find and vet people
note: Little is public yet: no funding round has been announced.

name: Labelbox
description: RL environments and evaluations for frontier labs, plus Alignerr, its network of expert trainers
note: Raised more than $100M (equity and a credit facility) in a Series E led by Infinitum Partners at $1.25B pre-money (14 Oct 2026); profitable in 2026.

name: Scale AI
description: Data labelling and evaluation for AI labs, governments and enterprises
note: Meta invested $14.3B for 49% (Jun 2025) and hired its CEO, Alexandr Wang; not counted as capital raised on this map.

name: Turing
description: Expert engineers and specialists who build training data and evaluations for frontier models
note: Raised a $111M Series E at $2.2B led by Khazanah Nasional (Mar 2025), taking its total to $225M.

name: Invisible Technologies
description: Expert-led training data and AI operations for labs and enterprises
note: Raised $100M in growth funding (Sep 2025); Bloomberg reported a valuation of more than $2B.

name: Prolific
description: Panel of verified, fairly paid people for research, human feedback and model evaluation
note: Bootstrapped until a £25M Series A co-led by Partech and Oxford Science Enterprises (Jul 2023).

name: Surge AI
description: Expert human data for training and evaluating frontier models
note: Bootstrapped. Reported (Reuters, Jul 2025) to be planning a first raise of up to $1B at more than $15B; no close confirmed.

name: Artificial Societies
description: AI personas that simulate how real audiences react to a message before it launches
note: Raised a $3.35M seed led by Point72 Ventures (Aug 2025), after a $2M pre-seed: $5.35M in total.
